description: This Java source file contains a Spring MVC controller class named CustomerOptionsSetController, responsible for managing customer options and option sets within the admin panel of a sales manager e-commerce application. It handles listing, saving, deleting, and updating customer option sets, and provides AJAX endpoints for pagination and modification of option set data.

classes.name: CustomerOptionsSetController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller class managing customer option sets in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of customer options and option sets for a store.

methods.name: saveOptionSet
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new customer option set, validating associations and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: pageOptionsSet
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to provide paginated data of customer option sets.

methods.name: deleteOptionSet
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to delete a customer option set by ID, with authorization and error handling.

methods.name: updateOrder
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to update the order of an option set.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the current menu context for the UI, used internally.
